verdict.rationale: Oyster documents an embedded offering: 'Oyster Embedded' with embeddable web components, an API to 'embed international employment anywhere', reseller/partner flows, and client-credentials auth for partner use cases. However, the embeddable surface evidenced is global hiring and EOR employment (create and submit employments, benefits, bonuses and allowances), not payroll runs specifically, and white-labeling is never stated. Missing for 10: explicit embedded payroll API endpoints, documented white-label/branding controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of an embedded partner integration.
